newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius stock exchange index, turnover down.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius stock exchange index, turnover down.

text.p: The SEMDEX index at the Stock Exchange of Mauritius eased 4.16 points to 351.32 and turnover fell on Friday, bourse officials said.
Turnover was down to 10.39 million rupees on 818,227 shares compared with 18.12 million rupees on 1,395,921 shares on Monday.
Mauritius Commercial Bank climbed 3.50 rupees to 80 rupees on 7,451 shares while State Bank of Mauritius gained 20 cents on 164,822 shares.
Sun Resorts was a rupee higher to 39 rupees on 20,610 shares and New Mauritius Hotels rose 1.90 rupees to 33.10 rupees on 39,000 shares.
National carrier Air Mauritius fell by 3 rupees to 47 rupees on 3,398 shares. Rogers lost 4.50 rupees to 90.50 rupees on 3,500 shares.
